SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.superhero WHERE weight_kg IS NULL) AS null_weights,
    (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM main.superhero) AS minimum_weight,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.superhero WHERE weight_kg < 0) AS negative_weights,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0) AS zero_weights,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.superhero WHERE typeof(weight_kg) NOT IN ('integer', 'null')) AS other_weight_types,
    colour
FROM main.colour
WHERE lower(colour) IN ('no colour', 'blue')
ORDER BY colour

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN s.weight_kg IS NULL THEN 'null' WHEN s.weight_kg = 0 THEN 'zero' ELSE 'positive' END AS weight_type,
    COUNT(*) AS heroes,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN s.height_cm IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_heights,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN s.height_cm <= 0 THEN 1 END) AS nonpositive_heights,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'No Colour' THEN 1 END) AS no_colour,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 END) AS blue
FROM main.superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN main.colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
GROUP BY weight_type
